note: This project's single-firmware catalog for the fm1-emu page (.github/workflows/pages.yml). The version field is injected at build time from the current release tag. "package" points to the latest release asset, published with a stable name across releases.

firmwares.name: Impressionism
firmwares.author: Darren Jaworski
firmwares.about: A generative ambient instrument in the harmonic language of Debussy/Ravel-era Impressionism: whole-tone and pentatonic drift, extended and quartal chords, parallel chord motion over a sustained drone, with no clocked sequencer. Forked from zvenson/dinghy.
